Container.Name: raccfo
Container.Overview: raccfo: the family den of apps. A raccoon-themed start page with a card for each of the family's self-hosted apps: what it does, what it replaces, screenshots, a link to open it, and the latest Android, TV and Windows downloads pulled from each app's GitHub releases.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the site. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Optional apps.json, icons/ and screenshots/ that override the built-in ones. Can stay empty.

Config.Name: Release cache minutes
Config.Description: How long to remember each app's GitHub releases before checking again

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional read-only token. Raises GitHub's limit from 60 to 5000 calls an hour.
